ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a regional map, with longitude values such as 75°, 72°, and 69° marked at the top and bottom. Point P is located in the upper-left part of the map, close to the meridian marked 75°. The question stem states that the ship sailed from the Pacific Ocean to the Atlantic Ocean and passed through this region, so the 75° meridian in the figure should be judged as 75°W. Then reason: The photo shows the time as 7th day 7:00:00 Beijing time, and Beijing time is calculated according to the local time at 120°E.
